profile_sketch.title: Profile sketch
profile_sketch.conflict_help: Conflicting rules are marked red. Make one dimension driven or delete one rule.
profile_sketch.err.driven: A driven dimension shows the measured value. Make it driving first.
profile_sketch.err.not_length: Value not accepted: a length is expected.
profile_sketch.err.negative: Value not accepted: a dimension cannot be negative.
profile_sketch.err.points: Enter existing point or line numbers.
profile_sketch.err.profile.empty: The sketch has no profile lines.
profile_sketch.err.profile.open: The profile is open: every point needs two profile lines.
profile_sketch.err.profile.branch: The profile branches: a point has more than two profile lines.
profile_sketch.err.profile.several: The sketch has more than one loop.
profile_sketch.add_dim_tip: Label above or below the points: horizontal; left or right: vertical; otherwise aligned. The value field opens at once.
profile_sketch.use_profile_tip: Copies the closed outline to the profile field. Construction lines are left out.
profile_sketch.scratch: scratch: not saved with the family
profile_sketch.undo_tip: Undo the last sketch step. Ctrl+Z undoes the sketch while the pointer or focus is in this panel, otherwise the family.
profile_sketch.redo_tip: Redo the sketch step. Ctrl+Y redoes the sketch while the pointer or focus is in this panel, otherwise the family.
profile_sketch.doc_undo_tip: Undo the last family edit. Ctrl+Z undoes the family, or the profile sketch while the pointer or focus is in the sketch panel.
profile_sketch.doc_redo_tip: Redo the family edit. Ctrl+Y redoes the family, or the profile sketch while the pointer or focus is in the sketch panel.
profile_sketch.ask.title: Discard the profile sketch?
profile_sketch.ask.body: {name} has a profile sketch. It is scratch work and is not saved with the family: closing discards it.
profile_sketch.ask.body_window: A family has a profile sketch. It is scratch work and is not saved with the family: closing the editor discards it.
profile_sketch.ask.body_dirty: {name} has changes that are not loaded into the project. Load them, discard them, or keep editing.
profile_sketch.ask.body_window_dirty: These families have changes that are not loaded into the project: {names}. Load them, discard them, or keep editing.
